card.title: Disney: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas

metadata.author: Disney
metadata.description:
Jack Skellington, Halloween Town’s Pumpkin King, longs for something new. After discovering the magic of Christmas Town, he hatches a plan to bring Christmas home, with the help of Sally the rag doll, his loyal dog Zero, and his fellow townsfolk.   

But with Sally’s dark premonitions of Jack falling into danger and the mysterious Oogie Boogie lurking, will Jack’s dream of creating the perfect Christmas come true . . . or is it destined to become an utter nightmare?  

A note from Yoto: This audiobook contains mature and sensitive themes and is best suited for listeners aged 9 and up.
